_doc: The small boats (user 2026-09-29: 'i want to add sailing in the game, like Black Flag' -> 'lets do a rowboat and battle canoes of that period', smaller boats, the river widened into a lake). Boat (scripts/boats/boat.gd) reads it. length/beam/draft in m, mass_kg the empty hull, crew the seats (seat 0 is the helm: the player), stroke_n one seat's push while it strokes (N), stroke_s a stroke's length (s), max_mps the speed it stops gaining at with everyone stroking, turn_dps how fast it can turn at speed, drag/side_drag the water's hold along and across it, ground_drag the scrape over shallows.
